provenance.basis: Independent adaptation of PlainChestScript and its default/duration constants. Two exact native location definitions, opening sequence, literal sound asset and Wiki Chest context are pinned. Existing Rust mutation, presentation and generation-aware restoration systems are reused. No protected donor code, DSL, tables or assets are copied.
restrictions: Root ISC does not establish blanket per-file or dependency clearance.

Protected source, cache, Wiki, private and historical native evidence remain local. Repository and registry files are narrow support references for add/timer semantics, not new whole-file migration claims.

registration_dispatch.role: Validate native closed375/Open1 and open378/Search2/Shut3, static footprints and sequence536 before returning three handlers.
Actual startup rejects handler conflicts before installing the plain chest pair.
Reached location dispatch retains protection, arrival and captured target identity checks.
Validate the cache root, pair, types and checked deadline, commit existing location mutation, and schedule the existing timer only for a spawned stage.
Read the underlying cache location on the occupied layer, including while a spawned stage masks it.
Reuse the existing collision-validated location transaction and zone projection; original add semantics are preserved.
Executable logs a typed switch with current tick, original/new states and optional root/deadline. Existing restoration logs report later restore or stale refusal.

dependencies: ENV: existing location reach/protection, cache location registry, collision-validated mutation, generic player animation/sound projection and generation-aware world restoration queue.
expected_normal_behavior: Closed chest375 operation1 opens to378, plays human_openchest536 and literal opening sound52. Open chest378 operation2 emits the source default message. Operation3 shuts to375 with animation536 and no closing sound. No item, XP, RNG, key, quest or thieving reward is introduced.

A spawned toggle schedules restoration to its actual underlying cache identity after500 ticks. Returning to the exact map state schedules no timer. A chest originally mapped open can therefore restore to open after a temporary shut; a normally mapped closed chest restores to closed.

Opening, shutting to the map state and reopening must retain the newer deadline. Older timers become stale through the existing generation guard and cannot close a more recent opening. Search remains message-only without the toggle arrival delay.
expected_negative_behavior: Stale captured target, missing or unrelated cache root, unknown stage, same-stage toggle, invalid duration/deadline overflow or rejected collision/region mutation must not switch stock or emit successful animation/sound/switch trace.

Only the exact native375/378 pair and operations1/2/3 are registered. Wrong symbols, names, operations, geometry, dynamic definitions or sequence identity refuse the complete binding batch. Unsupported dynamically spawned lookalikes without a compatible cache root refuse the toggle.
Key, quest, clue, locked and thieving chests are separate. A name containing Chest does not qualify for this adapter. No random loot or persistent container contents are inferred.

timing: Open and shut inherit source arriveDelay through the existing handler flag. The message-only search does not add that delay. A successful spawned stage restores at commit clock plus500 ticks; an exact map reset schedules none.

Wiki Chest supports the general mostly-empty scenery context and specialised chest exceptions. The exact500-tick duration and presentation identifiers are source/native observations requiring independent comparison.
transactions: Validate captured generation, underlying cache pair, types and checked deadline before the existing location transaction. Schedule a generation-aware restoration only after a successful spawned-stage mutation; publish presentation and the typed trace afterwards.

The same world timer handles plant and chest restorations. No feature-specific global stock state, second scheduler, inventory transaction or persistence schema is added. Source LocRepository.change delegates add, and the normal registry preserves masked map collision; existing Rust add semantics are retained.
